baseFrontend: single v82 NexoWatt native shell runtime with automatic legacy-file cleanup before checks, build and publishing

notes: Legacy runtime files are removed automatically before package checks, stability checks and npm packing.

Stability validation now self-heals stale runtime files before checking the active graph.
